subject: Companies Registry Letter - Harbour Light Limited
body:
Dear Ms Ann Ho,

We have received a letter from the Companies Registry for Harbour Light Limited. It is a reminder regarding the overdue delivery of the 2026 Annual Return (Form NAR1), stating that the annual return together with the appropriate fee should be delivered without delay.

A scan of the letter is attached for your reference. Please let us know if you would like us to assist you in preparing and filing the return.

Best regards,
XYZ CPA
